title: Jersey Top
subtitle: Olive off-shoulder top / asymmetric folded band
status: PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT SPECIFICATION — SAMPLE VALIDATION REQUIRED
fit: Soft body blouson above a close lower band; slim long sleeves; off-shoulder upper band.
market: Adult Womenswear / EU-labelled development range; no UK conversion implied

bom.specification: PROPOSED stable fine-gauge double jersey, 220–260 g/m²; ≥40% crosswise / ≥20% length extension without damage
bom.composition: TBD; viscose-rich blend with elastane is a sampling option

bom.specification: Core-spun polyester Tex 24 needle; soft textured polyester looper option; tune needle Nm 70–80 ballpoint
Soft 35 × 12 mm label; neutral AB-TP-01 / EU size; not retail brand artwork
bom.placement: Inner left side seam, 60 mm above lower-band seam

bom.specification: Content pending fibre and care verification; no preprinted wool/cotton claim
bom.placement: Inner left side seam below ID label

operations.method: Cut band with greatest stretch around body; fold double. Join short ends away from tab, 6 mm SA, 514 four-thread overedge, 2.8–3.0 mm stitch. Tab captures localized front folds at wearer left; secure to band only with concealed 301, no visible decorative tack.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Join sleeve cap to body under band, 6 mm SA using 514, 2.8–3.0 mm. Match front/back cap notches; zero woven-style cap ease. Band must cover junction when worn. Fit trial required.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Turn 20 mm; 406 two-needle coverseam, 4 mm needle gauge, 3 mm stitch. Catch raw edge inside. Test extension; no lockstitch-only load-bearing hem.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Close band ring at left side, 6 mm SA / 514. Fold wrong sides together and attach to relaxed body, distributing slight fullness evenly; proposed seam-line band/body ratio 0.90 at EU 38, adjust after recovery trial.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Plain folded band across back; do not add centre-back body seam. Align band join to left body side; conceal joining seam within folded construction. Press with low tension and test temperature.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Close underarm/side in one continuous pass where band sequence allows; superimposed join, 6 mm SA, 514, 3 mm stitch. Secure ends into band/hem. No seam twisting.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Keep overedge allowance toward back; use differential feed to avoid waviness. Trial seam extension ≥40% without stitch break; recover flat after 30 min.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Catch L01/L02 in wearer-left side seam with smooth edges away from skin. Position 60 mm above lower-band join. Care content remains TBD; do not attach unverified retail care artwork.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

details: Folded self band; tab attachment hidden inside. Proposed concealed sleeve junction, no exposed shoulder seam.
20 mm turn; 4 mm needle gauge; preserve crosswise extension. Stitch formation is not a flatseam.
Folded self band; proposed 0.90 seam-line ratio to body, verify after relaxation. No separate elastic specified.
pattern: Front ×1 on fold; back ×1 on fold; sleeves ×2 mirrored; upper band ×1 cut across stretch (piece/length trial); lower band ×1; tab ×1. These are proposed pattern components, not existing measured patterns.
Match sleeve cap/armhole lengths with no cap gathering; walk low-cap seam and notch front/back separately.
Tab gathering only at wearer-left front band; do not gather back band. Body fullness is absorbed at lower band; no invented body darts.
assembly: Relax knit 24 h; test extension, recovery and dimensional change before cutting.
Cut mirrored sleeves; mark band join, tab centre and low-armhole balance points.
Prepare upper band ring and tab; pretest tab fold bulk.
Join low sleeve caps to open body; close underarms and side seams.
Apply upper band to concealed neckline/cap edge; secure tab from inside.
Attach folded lower band; coverseam sleeve hems; attach development labels.
Steam without stretching; cool flat 24 h before measurement.
qc: Upper band lies level at back; front tab on wearer left; no accidental twisted band.
Reach trial: arms forward/raised, neckline remains comfortable; no sleeve-cap strain.
406 hems stretch without pop; 514 seams no tunnelling or grinning.
Check bust and bands after 24 h relaxation; all POMs within listed tolerances.
risks: Unverified knit recovery may cause neckline slip; do not solve by an unrecorded elastic addition.
Off-shoulder fit must be checked against actual upper-arm/chest dimensions and movement.
Shrinkage and tab bulk may change band length; revise after first prototype.
evidence: CONFIRMED in reference: olive colour family, long fitted sleeves, broad folded upper band, gathered tab on wearer-left front, plain folded band across back, lower body band.
Knit classification is a development interpretation supported by the portfolio knit reference; fibre, knit structure and elastic performance are untested.
No closure, pocket or exposed shoulder seam is visible. Back vertical shadows are folds, not specified panel seams.
assumptions: PROPOSED cut-and-sew jersey engineering, not a claim that an original fully-fashioned knitting pattern exists.
Upper sleeve/body junction is hidden by the folded band: use a low set-in sleeve with concealed cap seam; verify reach and band stability on body.
No separate inserted elastic at neckline in this issue. If recovery fails, revise BOM and upper-band construction together.
consumption: ESTIMATE: 1.25–1.55 m shell at 150 cm usable width, EU 38, non-directional knit, body pair + sleeve pair + long folded upper band + lower band + tab. Preliminary nesting: sleeves beside body where width permits; 15% cutting/shrink reserve. Verify after pattern, relaxation and marker; not an approved yield.
care: TBD: fibre identity, component compatibility, care testing, country of origin and destination-market legal review. Do not print generic care symbols.
labels: PROPOSED: neutral development ID + EU size; 35 × 12 mm soft ID label, ends turned 5 mm and secured with 301. No third-party logo or manufacturer claim. Placement: inner left side, 60 mm above band.
packaging: PROPOSED: fold only after cooling; use unprinted recyclable protective sleeve sized to the actual folded sample. Bag material, gauge and dimensions TBD after packing trial. One garment per sleeve; no invented approved bag size.

revision.change: Initial source-referenced development specification; no physical sample, marker or fit validation
